title: Global Corruption
description: Examines the nature, extent and consequences of global corruption. Focuses on global anti-corruption conventions and their adoption in the laws of USA, UK and Canada primarily in three areas: transnational business law, public law and criminal law enforcement.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of LAW 330A, LAW 343 (if taken as section A01 in Sep - Dec 2015, Jan - Apr 2017, Sep - Dec 2017 or Sep - Dec 2019).
